newsitem.title: FRANCE: France 1996 live air cargo exports down, value up.
newsitem.headline: France 1996 live air cargo exports down, value up.

text.p: The export of live animals (excluding chicks) from the Paris airports last year, expressed in tonnes, fell significantly in contrast to a steep rise in their customs value, French Ministry of Transport (MoT) figures show.
Export shipments totalled 245.4 tonnes, down 39.7 percent on 1995, and had a customs value of 349.7 million francs, an increase of 94.2 percent.
Live animal (excluding chicks) imports handled at the Paris airports last year totalled 649.6 tonnes, up 8.9 percent on 1995, with a customs value of 140.8 million francs, down 13.7 percent.
Global cargo traffic handled at the Paris airports in 1996 totalled 1.1 million tonnes, up 1.1 percent on 1995, Aeroports de Paris figures showed.
